title: Filling: the Instruction word, and where and when it opens
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a technician with 'Work order lines - Create & Edit', on the build under test.
  2. A filled inspection with a checkbox field carrying follow-ups on OK, Monitor, Not OK and N/A, some also requiring a note (seed the template accordingly).
custom_steps:
1. Confirm the technician-facing word is Instruction (Follow-up appears only in the builder).
2. Give a response that carries a follow-up and confirm the instruction opens in the field card, below the note block where a note is also required, above the footer, both blocks full width and never side by side.
3. Confirm on Monitor and Not OK the instruction opens in place as soon as the response is given, while on OK and N/A it stays collapsed with an Instruction action in the card footer beside Add Note and Add Photo.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The technician-facing word is Instruction; Follow-up is the authoring word and appears only in the builder.
  • Where the given response carries a follow-up, the instruction opens in the field card, below the note block where a note is also required and above the footer, both blocks full width and never side by side.
  • On Monitor and Not OK the instruction opens in place as soon as the response is given; on OK and N/A it stays collapsed with an Instruction action in the card footer beside Add Note and Add Photo.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-10243 (S19 — Conditional follow-up on a checkbox response); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S19; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S19-R13: “The technician-facing word is Instruction. Follow-up is the authoring word and appears only in the builder. The two are deliberately different: the author is configuring a rule, the technician is reading a procedure, and Instructions is already the name of a field type the technician knows”
  • S19-R14: “Where the given response carries a follow-up, the instruction will open in the field card, below the note block where a note is also required, above the footer. Both blocks are full width and never side by side”
  • S19-R15: “On Monitor and Not OK the instruction opens in place as soon as the response is given. On OK and N/A it stays collapsed and an Instruction action sits in the card footer beside Add Note and Add Photo”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
